## {.toolbar }

```{python}
#| output: false
#| echo: false

import sys, os

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "..")))
from src.backend.backend_functions import *

initialize_data()

# Adjust if your output_*.csv files live elsewhere.
DATA_DIR = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "..", "data"))
GROUP_PATH = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "output_group_analysis.csv")

# Fail here rather than three cells later with an opaque KeyError.
if not os.path.exists(GROUP_PATH):
    raise FileNotFoundError(GROUP_PATH)

group_raw = pd.read_csv(GROUP_PATH)

MODELS = ["v0", "v1", "v2"]

# Edit these once you want the covariate sets spelled out in the UI.
MODEL_LABELS = {"v0": "v0", "v1": "v1", "v2": "v2"}

# Per-model metrics stored wide as `<model>_<metric>`; reshape to long so the
# model selector works the same way the season selector does elsewhere.
METRICS = [
    "coef", "se", "z", "p", "or", "or_lower", "or_upper", "aic", "separation",
    "win_rate_lift_prob", "win_rate_lift_mean_prob",
    "win_rate_lift_pct", "win_rate_lift_mean_pct",
    "win_rate_lift_std", "win_rate_lift_mean_std",
    "p_adj", "significant_raw", "significant_fdr",
]

# Constant across models -- carried along for the cross-model stability view.
SHARED = [c for c in ["group_id", "group_name", "n_games_with_group",
                      "or_range", "or_mean", "or_cv"]
          if c in group_raw.columns]

frames = []
for model in MODELS:
    renames = {f"{model}_{m}": m for m in METRICS
               if f"{model}_{m}" in group_raw.columns}
    missing = [m for m in METRICS if f"{model}_{m}" not in group_raw.columns]
    if missing:
        raise KeyError(f"Model {model} is missing metrics: {missing}")
    part = group_raw[SHARED + list(renames)].rename(columns=renames)
    part.insert(0, "model", model)
    frames.append(part)

group_stats = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

for col in ["separation", "significant_raw", "significant_fdr"]:
    group_stats[col] = group_stats[col].astype(bool)

group_stats = group_stats.sort_values(
    ["model", "or"], ascending=[True, False]
).reset_index(drop=True)

models = [MODEL_LABELS[m] for m in MODELS]
model_lookup = {MODEL_LABELS[m]: m for m in MODELS}

ojs_define(
    models=models,
    model_lookup=model_lookup,
    # NB: do not name this `cards` -- that shadows the OJS stdlib `cards`
    # reactive that Quarto uses to autosize Plot.plot() calls in dashboards.
    group_stats=group_stats,
)
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: input
viewof modelLabel = Inputs.select(models, {
  label: "Model",
  value: models[models.length - 1]
})

viewof groupSearch = Inputs.text({
  label: "Search Group",
  placeholder: "Search group...",
  submit: false
})

viewof minGames = Inputs.number([0, Infinity], {
  label: "Min Games With Group",
  value: 0,
  step: 50
})

viewof sigOnly = Inputs.toggle({
  label: "FDR significant only",
  value: false
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
groupsData = transpose(group_stats)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
modelId = model_lookup[modelLabel]
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// The number input yields null when cleared; treat that as no minimum.
groupRows = {
  const query = (groupSearch ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  const floor = minGames ?? 0;
  return groupsData
    .filter(d =>
      d.model === modelId &&
      d.n_games_with_group >= floor &&
      (!sigOnly || d.significant_fdr) &&
      (query === "" || String(d.group_name).toLowerCase().includes(query))
    )
    .sort((a, b) => d3.descending(a.or, b.or));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
sigLevel = d => d.significant_fdr ? "FDR significant"
             : d.significant_raw  ? "p < 0.05 (raw)"
             : "Not significant"
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
sigDomain = ["FDR significant", "p < 0.05 (raw)", "Not significant"]
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
sigRange = ["var(--bs-primary)", "var(--bs-warning)", "var(--bs-secondary)"]
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Rank by effect size, not by p -- ties in p are common after FDR adjustment.
topGroups = groupRows
  .slice()
  .sort((a, b) => d3.descending(Math.abs(a.win_rate_lift_pct),
                                Math.abs(b.win_rate_lift_pct)))
  .slice(0, 5)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
fmtOR = d3.format(".3f")
fmtPP = d3.format("+.2f")
fmtP  = p => p < 0.001 ? d3.format(".2e")(p) : d3.format(".3f")(p)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
orCell = d => htl.html`<span style="font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums">${fmtOR(d)}</span>`

liftCell = x => htl.html`<span style="color: ${
  x > 0 ? "var(--bs-success)" : x < 0 ? "var(--bs-danger)" : "inherit"
}; font-weight: ${Math.abs(x) >= 2 ? 600 : 400};
   font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums">${fmtPP(x)} pp</span>`

pCell = p => htl.html`<span style="color: ${
  p < 0.05 ? "var(--bs-success)" : "inherit"
}; font-weight: ${p < 0.05 ? 600 : 400};
   font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums">${fmtP(p)}</span>`
```

## Column   {height="50%"}


```{ojs}
//| title: "Group Effect on Game Win: Odds Ratio (95% CI)"

//| title: "Group Effect on Game Win: Odds Ratio (95% CI)"

{
  if (groupRows.length === 0)
    return html`<p class="text-muted">No groups match the current filters.</p>`;

  // log scale can't show non-positive bounds; ignore them for the extent
  const lo = d3.min(groupRows, d => d.or_lower > 0 ? d.or_lower : null) ?? 1;
  const hi = d3.max(groupRows, d => d.or_upper > 0 ? d.or_upper : null) ?? 1;
  const xDomain = [Math.min(lo, 1) / 1.15, Math.max(hi, 1) * 1.15];

  return Plot.plot({
    height: Math.max(240, groupRows.length * 34 + 80),
    marginLeft: 190,
    marginRight: 30,
    marginBottom: 45,
    style: {fontSize: "13px"},
    x: {
      type: "log",
      label: "Odds Ratio (log scale)",
      grid: true,
      domain: xDomain,
      ticks: 6,
      tickFormat: d => d3.format(".2f")(d)
    },
    y: {label: null, domain: groupRows.map(d => d.group_name)},
    color: {
      domain: sigDomain,
      range: sigRange,
      legend: true,
      label: "Significance"
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleX([1], {
        stroke: "gray", strokeDasharray: "4,4", strokeOpacity: 0.6
      }),
      Plot.link(groupRows, {
        y: "group_name",
        x1: "or_lower",
        x2: "or_upper",
        stroke: sigLevel,
        strokeWidth: 2,
        strokeOpacity: 0.7
      }),
      // Whisker caps: `markerStart/markerEnd: "tick"` needs a newer Plot
      // than Quarto bundles, so draw them as marks instead.
      Plot.tickX(groupRows, {
        y: "group_name",
        x: "or_lower",
        stroke: sigLevel,
        strokeWidth: 2,
        strokeOpacity: 0.7,
        inset: 11
      }),
      Plot.tickX(groupRows, {
        y: "group_name",
        x: "or_upper",
        stroke: sigLevel,
        strokeWidth: 2,
        strokeOpacity: 0.7,
        inset: 11
      }),
      Plot.dot(groupRows, {
        y: "group_name",
        x: "or",
        fill: sigLevel,
        r: 6,
        stroke: "white",
        strokeWidth: 1,
        channels: {
          Group: "group_name",
          Games: "n_games_with_group",
          "95% CI": d => `${fmtOR(d.or_lower)} – ${fmtOR(d.or_upper)}`,
          "Win rate lift": d => `${fmtPP(d.win_rate_lift_pct)} pp`,
          "p (raw)": d => fmtP(d.p),
          "p (FDR)": d => fmtP(d.p_adj),
          AIC: d => d3.format(".1f")(d.aic)
        },
        tip: {format: {
          Group: true, Games: ",.0f", "95% CI": true, "Win rate lift": true,
          "p (raw)": true, "p (FDR)": true, AIC: true,
          x: false, y: false, fill: false, r: false
        }}
      })
    ]
  });
}
```
